extract_batch: mixed bytes and URL inputs share one output envelope

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract_batch
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    inputs = [{"kind": "uri", "uri": "https://example.com"}, {"bytes": [66, 97, 116, 99, 104, 32, 98, 121, 116, 101, 115, 32, 99, 111, 110, 116, 101, 110, 116], "filename": "inline.txt", "kind": "bytes", "mime_type": "text/plain"}]
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{\"url\":{\"mode\":\"document\"}}")
    result = await extract_batch(inputs, config)
    print(result.results)
    print(result.results[0].content)
    print(result.results[1].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
